content: Beduru Yaheiyaghalai Bareidene Asazho
BeduruYaheiyaghala kunlade kielien kieliekude buwala, mechii sagheisan duizhan, Sadugai kunla iredene
hhela bexinlade Ersai tungo giezhi fugusan kun fuho giesei surughazhi chonjise hende hokuzho.
Ingie hhelai barei agi, khara oluse khadene khuichudu kuwo.
Ingieliuzhe hhela jianjisan kielienni chenliedene xianxin giesan kun olon wo. Xianxin giesan ere kun 5000 gholuwo.
Khuichudu Yutai kunni noyen, zhanlao, jinwun hanjiala man Yelusalende hhantulawo.
Zui fugie buwa Yanasi, Gaiyafa, Yaheiya, Yalishanda, pse zui fugie buwani jiawuni kunla man hhende wine.
Hhela Beduru, Yaheiyaghalai dunda beighadene asawo, "Ta kienyi nenli, niereghala ene shiqinyi giezho?"
Qingiekude Bedurude Shenlin duruzhi hhelade kieliewo, "Bexinlai noyen, zhanlaolaya,
ta enedu ene dogholonyi jiere bijien giesan gou shiqin, pse hhe matugie goudasei bijiende asazhoshi

ta ashighala, Isilieni bexinla man mejiendu. Tai melie beizhi goudasan ene kunshi ta shizijia jiere ghadadene Huda fugusan kun dundase aminne olughasan Nasale kun Ersa Mexihani niereghala goudaghasan wo.
Ene Ersashi jinwunde ingiezhi kieliesan hhe wo,
Ersase chugo pse jiuichen uwo. Qienxiade matanyi jiuiku psedu nierei ese ogizho."
Hhela Beduru, Yaheiya ghuala fugie danzighala kieliesei uzhewo. Hhelade yama unhua wikui mejiedene ghanirawo. Pse ene ghua kunshi Ersare hhantuku wo giezho.
Hhe goudasan kun hhelare hhantu beisanyi chanladene hhelade yama kielieku kielien widawo.
Ingie BeduruYaheiyai zui fugie fayense khireigha giezhi fenfuladene goyalane shanlian giezhi kieliewo.
"Matan ene ghua kunyi matugiene? Hhela nie ghudureqi xienjighawo, jien Yelusalende sousan kunla man mejiene. Matan uwo giezhi kielie danema,
ene shiqin bexinlai dunda fugiedakuse ayizhi matan hhelai nie ayighaye. Ene kunyi niereghala pse bu chonji gie."
Ingie hhe ghualai uruzhi ire, Ersani niereghala kunlade pse bu jianji, ye bu surugha giewo.
BeduruYaheiyaghala kieliewo, "Tai kieliei chenlie, Hudai kieliei ulie chenliese, Hudai melie heshi winu uwo? Ta goyalane sumula.
Bijien chujieghezhi sonosusanne ulie kieliezhi ulie olune."
Noyenla hhelade yama faikui jiekou ereizhi khizhe dawo. Pse bexinla ene fashen giesan shiqin jiere Hudai kuaise hhe ghualai hende nie ayigha andaghawo.
Yenlai ene ghudureqighala goudaghasan kun 40 ji olune.
Tujila Danzii Fugiedagha Giezhi Onxian Giezho
BeduruYaheiyaghalai andaghadene hhela goya kunlane hhende echiwo. Fugie buwa, zhanlaolai kieliesan kielienyi goya kunladene kieliewo.
Hhela chenliedene Hudade nie zhugheghala fugiede kieliewo, "Asiman, zemin, hai, pse hhei sudorodu shihenilai man zhayaghazhi gonjisan Ezhan,
chi Shenlinyi tungo giezhi goya hojine, bijienyi xienren Dawudeni amanghala ingiezhi kieliewo,

content.text: Go minzula yale oronde wikui jihua giene?
Ezhanse, Ezhanni Mexihase fandui giene giezho.'

content: Hherode, Benjiu-Bilado ghuala ene chenshide niman kun, Isilie kunlare hhantuladene chi sunghu goudaghasan zhiguitu hoji Ersai qingiezhi fandui giezho.
Hhela giesanlashi man chii nenli, isighala eqighan jiejin giesan shiqin wo.
Ezhan, hhela ede bijienyi ayighasei chi nie uzhe. Hojiladene fugie danzi ogizhi chii kielienni kieliegha.
Chi nenline xienjighazhi gienlai goudagha. Chii zhiguitu hoji Ersai niereghala ghudureqi, fugie shiqin xienjigha."
Hhela onxian gie baluse hhantulasan oron gojiolu qii, hhelade man Shenlin duruzhi danzine fugiedagha, Hudai kielienni kielie qiiwo.
Yan Dunxiiliuzhe Hhantu Injizho
Xianxin giesan kunla zhughede, sumulasanla man nie wo. Kienliuzhe eneshi goyanughun wo ulie giene, man hhantu injizho.
Shitula fugie nenlighala Ezhan Ersa fuho giesande ganzhen beizho. Ingiese kunlade Hudai fugie nenjien irewo.
Hhelai dunda kiemade yama ese chaizho. Hhela ghazha, gielane huisan baerni agizhi iredene
shitulani melie jiese shitula zhao kunla injiku mutun ghughazhi ogiwo.
Nie Liwi kunyi nierei Yusufu giene. Saipuluside oluzho. Shitula hhei Banaba giezhi uruzho, isishi kunlade goude sughazhi kieliechen wo.
Hhe ghazhalane huidene baerni agizhi ire shitulai melie jiewo.
